title: orthopogon compositus
intro: Orthopogon compositus, commonly known as Vetiver grass or Khus-khus, is a type of perennial grass native to India and parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its extensive root system and aromatic oil, which is used for various medicinal and therapeutic purposes. The health benefits of Orthopogon compositus include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menstrual cramps and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include vetiverol, vetiverone, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic and antispasmodic.
